customManagers.description: Versions pinned with a '# renovate:' comment above an ARG in the Dockerfile (AmneziaWG)

packageRules.description: AmneziaWG releases merge themselves once every check is green (the smoke test connects a real AmneziaWG client), so :latest follows them. Renovate checks the status itself: main has no required checks for GitHub's auto-merge to wait for

Alpine base image (new Alpine = new OpenVPN, WireGuard tools, iptables): merges itself once every check is green, including the smoke test with real OpenVPN, WireGuard and AmneziaWG clients; the merge then publishes :latest
